description: Composite of twelve bright-field TEM micrographs, panels (a)–(l), each with a 500 nm scale bar, documenting the deformation-induced microstructure of a low-carbon low-density (Fe35Mn6Al0.1C) steel deformed in tension at room temperature. Insets in (a)–(g) and (i)–(k) are selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns with a green quadrilateral drawn over the reflections (austenite-type FCC spot pattern, no indices printed). (a) 3 %: arrowed dislocation multi-junctions, dislocation nodes and dislocation pairs along a dashed {111} trace. (b), (c) 10 %: dashed {111} traces with labels LC and HDDWs (high-density dislocation walls). (d) 20 %: "Taylor lattices" with crossed {111} traces. (e) 20 %: "Cell blocks" and CBWs; (f) 20 %: DCs with a double-headed TA (tensile axis) arrow. (g) 28 %: cell blocks with arrows pointing to twins; (i) 28 %: DCs plus TA; (j) 28 %: "Microbands" marked by parallel dashed lines. Panels (h) (labelled "28" without %) and (l) 38 % show one and two thin lamellar bands respectively, with no diffraction inset. The group argues that with increasing strain the dislocation substructure evolves from planar-slip configurations to cell blocks/dislocation cells, with a small amount of deformation twinning nucleating along cell-block walls at 28 %.

observations.observation: The figure is a twelve-panel TEM montage, panels (a)-(l), each carrying a 500 nm scale bar.
Panel (a) is annotated with three distinct dislocation configurations: 'Dislocation multi-junctions', 'Dislocation nodes' and 'Dislocation pairs', and marks a {111} trace with a dashed line.
Panels (b) and (c) carry the labels 'LC' (Lomer-Cottrell locks) and 'HDDWs' (high-density dislocation walls) respectively, both at 10 % strain.

Panel (d) is annotated 'Taylor lattices' with crossed {111} slip-plane traces; panel (e) is annotated 'Cell blocks' and 'CBWs'; panel (f) is annotated 'DCs' with a double-headed arrow labelled 'TA' (tensile axis).
Panel (j) shows parallel dashed lines labelled 'Microbands'; panels (g) and (k) contain arrows labelled 'twins' pointing to thin planar features along cell-block walls.

Panels (h) and (l) display one and two thin elongated lamellar bands respectively against a largely featureless matrix and contain no diffraction inset; the label of (h) reads '28' without a percent sign.
SAED insets in (a)-(g) and (i)-(k) show spot patterns with a green quadrilateral superimposed on the reflections; no reflection indices or zone axes are printed anywhere in the figure.
The caption states the panels correspond to tensile strains of 3 % (a), 10 % (b, c), 20 % (d-f), 28 % (g-j) and 38 % (k, l).
The caption states that deformation twinning occurs at 28 % tensile strain in this RT-deformed steel.
The citing text attributes the 3 % configuration (dislocation nodes, multiple dislocations, dislocation pairs) to planar slip.

The citing text states that after 20 % strain Taylor lattices, cell blocks (CBs) and dislocation cells (DCs) form along {111} slip planes, with type I grains oriented close to <100>//TA forming dislocation cells and type II/III grains oriented away from <100>//TA forming cell blocks.

The citing text states that at 28 % strain the cell blocks and dislocation cells are refined, a small amount of deformation twinning forms along the cell block walls, and a few microbands indicate stress localization.

The citing text states that at 38 % strain deformation twins parallel to the primary slip plane are further developed but their proportion remains very low, consistent with EBSD results in Fig. 5(a1, a2).
No numeric strain or stress values other than the strain percentages in the panel labels are printed on the panels themselves.

subfigures.description: Labelled 3 %. Bright-field TEM with arrowed annotations 'Dislocation multi-junctions', 'Dislocation nodes' and 'Dislocation pairs', a dashed line marked {111}, a 500 nm scale bar and an SAED inset with a green quadrilateral around the reflections.
Labelled 10 %. Dense dislocation wall structure with a dashed {111} trace and a short arrow labelled 'LC' (Lomer-Cottrell locks); 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset with green quadrilateral.
Labelled 10 %. Elongated dark bands enclosed by dashed lines labelled 'HDDWs' (high-density dislocation walls); 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 20 %. Text annotation 'Taylor lattices' with crossed dashed lines marking {111} slip-plane traces; 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 20 %. Annotations 'Cell blocks' and 'CBWs' with dashed {111} traces and small arrows; 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 20 %. Annotation 'DCs' (dislocation cells) and a double-headed arrow labelled 'TA' (tensile axis); 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 28 %. Annotations 'Cell blocks' and 'twins' (arrow to a thin planar feature along the block wall); 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled '28' (no % symbol). A single thin elongated dark band running across an otherwise featureless matrix; 500 nm scale bar, no SAED inset.
Labelled 28 %. Annotation 'DCs' and a double-headed arrow labelled 'TA'; 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 28 %. Parallel dashed lines marking 'Microbands' across a dislocation-walled region; 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 38 %. Annotations 'Cell blocks' and 'twins' with a small dashed circle and arrows marking thin twin lamellae; 500 nm scale bar and SAED inset.
Labelled 38 %. Two parallel thin lamellar bands on a featureless background; 500 nm scale bar, no SAED inset.
